newsitem.title: FRANCE: Striking French miners occupy management offices.
newsitem.headline: Striking French miners occupy management offices.

text.p: Striking French miners occupied the offices of state-owned potassium mines in Wittelsheim, eastern France, on Thursday in protest against a state plan to close down the mines by the year 2004.
The strikers were holding four to five management officials in the offices after letting several other administrative employees leave the building earlier in the day.

Five miners' unions are demanding job guarantees for the estimated 800 to 900 people who will still be working in the mines when they shut down, as currently planned, in 2004. The workforce now numbers 2,400.
Management has offered to begin talks with the miners only after they agree to leave the headquarters.
